name: Pilot and ignition systems (pilots, igniters, flame scanners, BMS sequencing)
description: Provide a reliable ignition source for pilot and main burners and prove flame presence before fuel is admitted; burner management system (BMS) sequences purge, pilot trial-for-ignition, flame proof, main flame light-off and shutdown, while a separate combustion control system meters fuel/air. Flame scanners with background-flame discrimination allow light-off and verification from the control room. Primary source: https://www.johnzink.com/products/flare-systems/instafire-rapid-pilot-monitoring-and-ignition-system
